pages.text: Mystical Agriculture grows resources like crops. Here, every tier has to be earned elsewhere in the world first.

Seeds are made on an $(l:magic/mystical#mystical_infusion_altar)Infusion Altar$(/l) ringed by eight $(l:magic/mystical#mystical_infusion_altar)Pedestals$(/l). Every resource seed starts as a $(l:magic/mystical#mystical_prosperity_seed_base)Prosperity Seed Base$(/l), and every base needs a mandrake root. Crops only drop a second seed on Essence Farmland, more often on their own tier's. An $(l:magic/mystical#mystical_prosperity_seed_base)Infusion Crystal$(/l) wears out.
